about: What each model the workers run can do, keyed by the model name pool.json and scheduler.json use. The categories and field names follow models.dev and OpenRouter (release_date, knowledge, open_weights, modalities, limit, tool_call, reasoning), so values can be checked against or copied from them, or from the model card named in source; benchmarks are the model card's own published scores, by benchmark name. limit.context is the model's own window; the server may be configured smaller (the scheduler shows what vLLM serves). short is the name shown on a worker's title bar. A worker whose model is a server alias (such as spark) is matched by the model the server says it serves (vLLM's root in /v1/models) against each entry's key, name or source; list other names an entry is served under in served. Unknown values are null. The scheduler reads this file from main and shows a summary on each worker's window; the planner can use it to judge which worker suits a card.
